verdict.rationale: Supermemory builds a knowledge graph, so schema customization is a fair axis. The evidence shows no way to define custom entity types, edge types, or an ontology; extraction is described as automatic. The closest features are adjacent and earn no credit: ingestion guidance on what content matters, profile 'buckets' as topical categories, and metadata filtering on custom properties.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
